Image inside an anchor produces a linked image

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<a href=\"https://example.com\"><img src=\"icon.png\" alt=\"Icon\"></a>", options: _options)
print(result)
```
